feature_cache_drift.scope: First2 cache rows only; no inference that the complete old cache is identical. All methods below receive the same current rebuilt cache.

summary.scope: Posthoc same-current-cache diagnostic of fixed old full-data models; original h bytes differ and original selected epochs unchanged. Types add input equally to all5. No new formal training, independent confirmation, quantum necessity or L5 acceptance. Do not replace historical reports.

residual.scope: All four fixed nonuniform heads, same rebuilt VALID cache and unchanged type rule. Reused development evidence; no new method, oracle score, independent confirmation or causal attribution.
residual.caution: Common false negatives do not prove missing token binding, quantum advantage or representation impossibility. Rule-excluded golds are empirical support failures. Training budgets differ from the separate pooled reference.
